title: scrumia-impl-reactjs — ScrumIA
meta_description: scrumia-impl-reactjs: the ScrumIA implementation slot for React 19 — Server Components by default, Actions for mutations, derived state during render, behaviour-first component tests.
tagline: Server Components by default, derived state during render, Actions for everything that was an effect.
responsibilities: Owns the how for a React 19 app: Server Components and the App Router treated as the default, derived state calculated during render rather than inside effects, mutations and forms written as Actions, and a structure organised by feature. Ships an audit skill for the React reflexes that creep back in.
refusals: No useEffect for state that can be calculated during render, no imperative DOM escape hatch, no effect where an event handler answers the same question, no "use client" that ships a whole dependency tree to the browser for no reason.
philosophy: Assumes React 19's mental model — server by default, render is pure, transitions are interruptible — is worth learning rather than carrying React 16 reflexes over. Costs the unlearning of patterns that compile but stop being idiomatic.
